dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a high-degree inward curvature starting from the upper third of the vertical height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly rounded apex with a small pixel radius, truncated on the posterior side by a jagged indentation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear ascent at approximately a 40-45 degree angle relative to the horizontal base axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Highly elongated horizontal base relative to vertical height, approximately 3.2:1 ratio.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct jagged notch or irregular tissue loss is visible at the apex along the upper trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The posterior base of the fin features an exceptionally long, tapering horizontal extension.
